description: List the videos in a YouTube playlist — an ordered video collection, the equivalent of a Bilibili 收藏夹/合集. The url parameter accepts a full playlist URL (youtube.com/playlist?list=...) or just the list ID (PL..., UU..., etc.). Returns playlist title and channel plus video entries (video ID, title, URL, duration). Scrolls internally up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when the list is exhausted. When logged in, the built-in personal lists also work: list=WL (Watch Later 稍后观看) and list=LL (Liked videos 赞过的视频). No authentication required for public playlists.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Playlist URL (youtube.com/playlist?list=PL...) or bare list ID. Discovery: a channel's Playlists tab (/@handle/playlists), the save/share dialog on any video, or the special IDs WL (Watch Later) and LL (Liked videos) when logged in.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of videos to return (1-100, default 50). Scrolls internally; partial=true when the playlist ends.
